intro.text: A food eaten in the Final Empire on Scadrial.
A food of the Final Empire on Scadrial: thin flatbread rolled into a cylinder around a filling of boiled barley and vegetables, eaten by skaa who can afford it.

description.text: Ham can get through four at one meal, while Vin thinks even three would be more than she could ever eat at once.
Kelsier's crew eats them often at Clubs's shop and at Lord Renoux's mansion, so often that Kelsier grows a little sick of them.
